Making a banking system legible to its regulator.

Strengthening Institutional Capacity to Compile and Analyze Financial Soundness Indicators

National consultant on ADB’s regional technical assistance for financial soundness indicators: balance-sheet data for 400 non-financial corporations and indicator guidelines for Bangladesh Bank and the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics.

Role
specialist

2014 – 2015

400non-financial corporations’ balance sheets

C13 · from the record

What I did.

  1. Assessed national accounts activities with focus on financial intermediation sectors and financial balance sheet information for 400 non-financial corporations across major economic sectors in five divisions.
  2. Designed Indicator Development Guidelines for Bangladesh Bank and the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics for compiling and analyzing Financial Soundness Indicators.

The assignment.

The TA helps participating developing member countries strengthen institutional and statistical capacity to collect, compile and disseminate internationally comparable Financial Soundness Indicators.
